cheatNotes: _` Unlocks Battle Modes (Ratio Match / 3 on 3 Match / Single Match) and CPU Battles
- On the Game Test Mode, go to PASSWORD and enter a password below:
YAMAOOUT = Unlocks BATTLE TYPE on the GAME CONFIGURATION
MORIKAWA = Unlocks BATTLE TYPE on the GAME CONFIGURATION and CPU Battles
_` CPU Battles
- Needs to be unlocked with Password first
_` Fight Bison on Stage 5
- Use S-GROOVE / N-GROOVE / K-GROOVE
- Never get hit by more than 5 "First Attacks"
- Win 2 rounds with a Super Combo / Custom Combo
- Get 800 Groove Points
_` Fight Geese on Stage 5
- Use C-GROOVE / A-GROOVE / P-GROOVE
- Never get hit by more than 5 "First Attacks"
- Win 2 rounds with a Super Combo / Custom Combo
- Get 800 Groove Points
_` Fight Shin Akuma after the Final Stage
- Use S-GROOVE / N-GROOVE / K-GROOVE
- Do at least two of the following:
- Get 1500 Groove Points
- Get a Dramatic KO
- Defeat Bison
_` Fight Ultimate Rugal after the Final Stage
- Use C-GROOVE / A-GROOVE / P-GROOVE
- Do at least two of the following:
- Get 1500 Groove Points
- Get a Dramatic KO
- Defeat Geese
_` Dramatic KO
- Defeat your opponent by doing one of the following:
- Counter a Super Combo with a Special Move / Super Combo
- Counter a Special Move with a Level 3 Super Combo
- Hit a taunting opponent with a Level 3 Super Combo
